license.restrictedDescription: The license is inactive, invalid, or expired. Activate it to restore all features.
license.permanentDescription: The license is permanent and has no expiration date.
license.copyFailed: Copy failed. Copy the machine ID manually.
license.invalidLicenseCode: Invalid license code. Use six groups of four letters or digits separated by hyphens.
license.pasteOrUploadBundle: Paste or upload the entitlement bundle
license.licenseCodePlaceholder: Enter a license code, for example WNWM-P5X3-VSN9-28FD-99RD-174Y
license.bundlePlaceholder: Paste the entitlement bundle or import a file above
license.instructionFindNode: Find this node in Cloud management → Edge nodes, matching its machine ID.
license.instructionIssue: Choose License or Create license for the node, then select and issue a license code.
license.instructionPasteCode: Copy the issued license code and paste it in the License code tab below.
license.instructionPasteBundle: Alternatively, copy the issued entitlement bundle or download its file, then use the Paste bundle tab.
license.activationDescription: Enter a license code from the cloud, or paste an issued entitlement bundle or import its file.
license.licenseCodeHelp: Issue license codes under Cloud management → Edge nodes. Each code binds to one machine.
license.expiringSoonDescription: The license expires on {date} ({days} days left). Contact your provider to renew it.
license.validUntilDescription: The license is valid until {date} ({days} days left).
